+## Summary
+
+Increases the pricing cache TTL from 15 minutes (900 seconds) to 1 hour (3600 seconds) to reduce feed processing overhead and improve performance.
+
+## Changes
+
+- Raised `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` from 900 to 3600 seconds
+- Removed the unused `lookup` function that was previously a fallback mechanism for late feed updates
+
+## Rationale
+
+The longer cache duration reduces the frequency of pricing feed lookups, which decreases processing overhead and improves system performance. The 1-hour TTL provides a good balance between cache freshness and system load.
+
+## Testing
+
+- Verify that pricing data remains reasonably fresh with the new TTL
+- Monitor cache hit rates to confirm improved performance
+- Ensure pricing updates within the 1-hour window are acceptable for business requirements
